name: movebenchvibe
postCreateCommand:
mkdir -p /root/.codex && printf 'approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"
[features]
web_search_request = true
[sandbox_workspace_write]
network_access = true
' > /root/.codex/config.toml && conda run -n movebench python -m pip install --upgrade pip && conda run -n movebench python -m pip install -e ./movebench && conda run -n movebench python -m pip install -r ./vibecleaning/requirements.txt && conda run -n movebench python -m ipykernel install --user --name movebench --display-name 'Python (movebench)'
